profile.headline: Senior Frontend Developer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
- Pixel-perfect attitude
- UX in mind from back then when UX was called HCI (Human-Computer Interaction)
- Amazing UI elements cooking
- Motion Design and Interaction Design
- Prototyping and wire-framing in Sketch
- Optimising
- Constant planing with "Bigger picture" in mind + constant testing with "user" in mind
- User Journey Mapping ...long before the term was around

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Over a couple of weekends implemented a prototype that has replaced an existing solution
- Actively using modern technologies (React, Redux, ES6, PostCSS, Sentry)
- Aggressively improving team's code quality (ESLint, Stylelint, writing tests, reviewing and automation of pull-requests)

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: Dabbled in Ember, Meteor, Angular, D3 and Ionic.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Worked directly with UI and UX,  laid all main pages out, communicated with designers and back-end developers. 

I used Sketch and my default stack: React.js + Flux, sometimes Angular, LESS, my own frameworks and libs... We also used Jade.
